events.reason: Atlanta placed starting boundary corner A.J. Terrell Jr. on injured reserve with a groin injury. C.J. Henderson finished Week 2 in his place, but the club says Henderson could remain outside while Avieon Terrell also has inside-outside flexibility. That leaves a live multi-role configuration involving existing baseline contributors, not a verified one-for-one replacement or value-invariant committee. Preserve the prior fair and record no numeric personnel move.

Green Bay confirmed starting right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele tore his patellar tendon and is out for the season. The current depth chart lists Anthony Belton behind him, but Belton is himself limited with an elbow injury and the surrounding Packers line also has active injuries. The Week 3 replacement configuration is therefore not confirmed as a healthy one-for-one case. Preserve the prior fair and record no numeric move.

Alec Pierce is expected to miss several weeks with a heel injury. Indianapolis signed Darius Slayton, while its current depth chart also lists Laquon Treadwell behind Pierce and retains Josh Downs and Keenan Allen in the receiver rotation. That is a multi-player workload redistribution, not a verified one-for-one replacement or value-invariant committee. Preserve the prior fair and record no numeric move.

Indianapolis placed rotational edge defender Micheal Clemons on injured reserve. The current depth chart shows multiple edge contributors and no confirmed one-for-one workload transfer. The defensive-line cluster and baseline contributors were reviewed; the case is not eligible for a numeric personnel or M4 move. Preserve the prior fair.

New England officially placed starting offensive lineman Mike Onwenu on injured reserve, and the club's current Week 3 depth chart names Greg Van Roten as the starting right guard. This is a verified one-for-one current-role replacement with both players present in the frozen Walters registry. Submit it to the governed personnel calculator; no manual points were assigned and no market information was viewed.

Detroit placed starting safety Avonte Maddox on injured reserve after confirming season-ending foot surgery and added Bishop Fitzgerald to the active roster. The current secondary already has multiple unavailable contributors, and the depth chart plus roster move leave a live multi-role redistribution involving Christian Izien, Thomas Harper, Bishop Fitzgerald and Chuck Clark rather than a stable one-for-one replacement. Preserve the prior fair.
